# nlmixr2data

The goal of nlmixr2data is to include all the example datasets from the
nlmixr2 project in one place.

## Example

This shows the `theo_sd` dataset, the hello world for nlmixr2.

``` r

library(nlmixr2data)
head(theo_sd)
#>   ID TIME    DV     AMT EVID CMT   WT
#> 1  1 0.00  0.00 319.992  101   1 79.6
#> 2  1 0.00  0.74   0.000    0   2 79.6
#> 3  1 0.25  2.84   0.000    0   2 79.6
#> 4  1 0.57  6.57   0.000    0   2 79.6
#> 5  1 1.12 10.50   0.000    0   2 79.6
#> 6  1 2.02  9.66   0.000    0   2 79.6
```

## Installation

You can install the development version of nlmixr2data from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("nlmixr2/nlmixr2data")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Bolus_1CPT`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Bolus_1CPT.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model Simulated Data from ACOP 2016
- [`Bolus_1CPTMM`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Bolus_1CPTMM.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model w/ Michaelis-Menten Elimination
- [`Bolus_2CPT`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Bolus_2CPT.md)
  : 2 Compartment Model
- [`Bolus_2CPTMM`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Bolus_2CPTMM.md)
  : 2 Compartment Model with Michaelis-Menten Clearance
- [`Infusion_1CPT`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Infusion_1CPT.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model Simulated Data from ACOP 2016
- [`Infusion_1CPTMM`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Infusion_1CPTMM.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model w/MM elimination Simulated Data from ACOP 2016
- [`Infusion_2CPT`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Infusion_2CPT.md)
  : 2 Compartment Model with Infusion Simulated Data from ACOP 2016
- [`Infusion_2CPTMM`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Infusion_2CPTMM.md)
  : 2 Compartment Model w/MM elimination Simulated Data from ACOP 2016
- [`Oral_1CPT`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Oral_1CPT.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model with Oral Absorption Simulated Data from ACOP
  2016
- [`Oral_1CPTMM`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Oral_1CPTMM.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model w/ Oral Absorption & Michaelis-Menten
  Elimination
- [`Oral_2CPT`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Oral_2CPT.md)
  : 2 Compartment Model with Oral Absorption Simulated Data from ACOP
  2016
- [`Oral_2CPTMM`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Oral_2CPTMM.md)
  : 1 Compartment Model w/ Oral Absorption & Michaelis-Menten
  Elimination
- [`Wang2007`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/Wang2007.md)
  : Simulated Data Set for comparing objective functions
- [`invgaussian`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/invgaussian.md)
  : Inverse Guassian absorption model
- [`mavoglurant`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/mavoglurant.md)
  : Mavoglurant PK data
- [`metabolite`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/metabolite.md)
  : Parent/Metabolite dataset
- [`neonatal_wt`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/neonatal_wt.md)
  : Neonatal weight progression data
- [`nimoData`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/nimoData.md)
  : Nimotuzumab PK data
- [`nmtest`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/nmtest.md)
  : One compartment test dataset showing NONMEM 7.4.3 output
- [`pheno_sd`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/pheno_sd.md)
  : Single Dose Phenobarbitol PK/PD
- [`pump`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/pump.md) :
  Pump failure example dataset
- [`rats`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/rats.md) :
  Pregnant Rat Diet Experiment
- [`theo_md`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/theo_md.md)
  : Multiple dose theophylline PK data
- [`theo_sd`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/theo_sd.md)
  : Multiple dose theophylline PK data
- [`warfarin`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/warfarin.md)
  : Warfarin PK/PD data
- [`wbcSim`](https://nlmixr2.github.io/nlmixr2data/reference/wbcSim.md)
  : Simulated Friberg Myelosuppression model (Yuan Xiong)
